source: Official university websites and Wikimedia Commons file pages (license and author metadata as published on each file page), researched 2026-10-26
policy: An image is approved only when its Commons file page publishes a license that permits redistribution with attribution (CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA) and a verifiable author; otherwise the image stays null and the card uses the local fallback.
download_url is the exact resource the uploader may fetch; width/height and byte size were verified by request on the research date. The original file (description_page) is the provenance of record.

Website URLs are the universities' own domains, verified by fetching the homepage on the research date. Korea University and Yonsei University roots issue JavaScript language redirects; the domains themselves are official.
When a faculty is added or a partner changes, re-verify this manifest; stale download URLs fail the uploader's checksum/size gates rather than uploading wrong bytes.

website.note: Root issues a JavaScript redirect to the language-specific home (/sites/ko/ or /sites/en/); both verified reachable.

Thumbnail variants (thumb.wikimedia.org, 1920px render of a 1600px request) are used for the three large originals to keep storage objects under ~1.1MB; the two smaller originals are fetched directly.
CC BY-SA 3.0 (Korea University) requires the same attribution and share-alike terms for derivative uses of the image itself; the card displays the attribution line as recorded.
